page: Microsoft Azure M48pds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on dedicated 64-bit ARM architecture under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 48 dedicated ARM vCPUs paired with 768 GB of system memory, delivering an extensive 16 GB of RAM per vCPU core. This high memory-to-CPU ratio caters directly to workloads requiring substantial memory space without demanding excessive core footprints.

For local disk requirements, the instance provides 2835 GB of integrated NVMe SSD storage alongside support for Azure Premium Storage. The bundled high-speed local NVMe volume delivers fast scratch disk and low-latency ephemeral cache space, reducing dependence on remote disks for temporary transactional data. The configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and operates without discrete hardware acceleration, containing zero GPUs.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 platform offers a high-density memory profile relative to virtual compute resources. This architecture enables efficient resource sizing for operational tiers that depend primarily on memory capacity and rapid local caching rather than x86-specific execution pipelines or GPU compute.

Microsoft Azure M48pds_v4 is engineered for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, including large-scale in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, real-time analytics engines, and transactional database systems that benefit directly from high memory-per-core density and local NVMe storage.
